subject: Nimbus: onramp sizing validation and cutover cadence (Hosted→Dedicated)
messages:
From: Oliver Tate <oliver.tate@nimbushealth.com>
To: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Priya Singh <priya@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Oct 2028 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Onramp sizing and swap cadence questions

Hi Ava / Redwood team,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We9re ramping faster than expected and need to lock the hosted→dedicated handoff timeline. Two asks from ops: 1) a validated GPU sizing recommendation for peak 2) a clear swap/cutover cadence (what blackout windows, how many staged swaps, rollback plan).

Our current hosted traffic: 180 rps at median load, 12% p95 token latency SLAs for critical endpoints. Peak day forecast for Dec looks like ~2.5x current. We9d like a plan that minimizes latency regressions and keeps unit cost within the committed range.

Can you share a concise validation run plan and an initial cutover timeline we can present to procurement?

Attachments: none from us.

Thanks,
Oliver
Senior Infra Ops, Nimbus Health

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Tate <oliver.tate@nimbushealth.com>, Priya Singh <priya@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Oct 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp sizing and swap cadence questions

Hi Oliver / Priya —

Thanks for the context. I9ve sketched a compact validation + cutover proposal and attached a small workbook that maps traffic tiers to GPU mixes. High-level notes below; details are in the attachment (nimbus_proposed_capacity_v1.xlsx).

Plan summary (short):
- Validation window: 2-week staged validation starting 2028-11-13 — includes golden traffic replay, mirrored traffic at 10/30/50/100% of live, and KV-prefix caching calibration.
- Sizing baseline: For current median (180 rps) we recommend starting with a 4x A100-like GPU pool for warmups; peak-day (2.5x) sizing shows ~10 GPUs when using 16-bit quantized variants and prefix caching. The workbook has throughput curves and token-cost estimates.
- Cutover cadence: three-stage swap across a weekend: 1) smoke + warm-pass (non-prod routing) 2) canary with 5% traffic for 3 hours then 25% for 6 hours 3) full swap with 60-minute rollback window.
- Safety nets: automatic fallback to hosted variant of the model (30s kill switch), health threshold alerts, and pre-authorized scale-up to burst capacity.

Attachments: nimbus_proposed_capacity_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) — throughput curves, cost delta table, rollback checklist.

Action items:
1) Oliver: confirm blackout windows (we proposed Sat 02:00–08:00 PT)
2) Priya / procurement: confirm PO timeline so we can book Dedicated capacity in the target region
3) Karthik/Ben: I9ve asked for a quick sizing calibration on our staging cluster this week — expected run Monday.

I9ll follow up with a condensed cadence PDF (cutover_cadence_v2.pdf) before Friday.

— Ava
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nimbus sizing — quick calibration notes

Ava / Ben —

Ran the warm replay on staging (attached internal notes). Quick observations:
- With continuous batching and KV cache enabled, 4xA100-equivalent sustains 220 rps with median token latency ~9ms; p95 climbs to ~38ms under synthetic p95 traffic.
- Quantized float16 model shows ~22% GPU memory reduction with ~1.09x token latency overhead vs fp32 — acceptable for Nimbus.
- For the 2.5x peak we9re looking at an operational target of 9–11 GPUs depending on the exact sequence length distribution; the workbook takes the conservative 11.

Recommend: 1) reserve 12 GPUs for Dedicated commit (gives 1 spare for maintenance) 2) pre-approve a burst pool of +4 GPUs for the first 30 days post-swap if traffic overshoots.

I added a short checklist for the cutover runbook and flagged the health thresholds (error rate >1.2% or p95 token latency +30% triggers rollback).

-Karthik
Platform Performance Lead

- Proposed start of reservation: 2028-11-20 (we9d like a week buffer before validation)
- Billing cadence and credits: we can offer a 6% first-quarter onboarding credit if PO is signed within 30 days of proposed reservation start.

If that looks OK I9ll generate the SOW/PO template and sync with finance. Also propose a single-day priming window (non-peak) on 2028-11-17 for network/ACL handshakes.
